events.Details: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 and payment of Interim Dividend (if any)

This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 29th October 2026, inter alia, to consider the following:1.Approval of audited standalone financial results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026; 2.Approval of unaudited consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026; and 3.Declaration of interim dividend, if any, for the financial year ending 31st March 2027. It is further informed that the record date for payment of interim dividend, if declared, will be Wednesday, 4th November 2026.
